config.title: WTF Commit
config.advanced.title: WTF Commit › Advanced
config.commitMessageLanguage: **Commit Message Language** — Language for the generated commit message (not the extension UI). When set to `Custom`, also set `wtfCommit.customCommitMessageLanguage` in `settings.json` (e.g. `French`, `Emoji only`).
config.provider: **Provider** — Default is **DeepSeek** (`deepseek-flash` / V4.1 Flash, pay-as-you-go). Choose **OpenCode Go** for subscription quota ([subscribe](https://opencode.ai/go?ref=J9E8732NMP)), **Gemini** for free tier (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`), **OpenAI** (`gpt-5.6-luna`), or **OpenRouter** / **Custom** for other OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Leave Model empty for built-in defaults.
config.autoCommit: **Auto Commit** (default on): Commit after generate. Turn off to only fill Source Control. **Auto Push** only runs when this is on.
config.autoPush: **Auto Push** (default off): After auto-commit, push to the remote. Requires **Auto Commit**. Use **Confirm Before Push** as a safety gate.
config.confirmAutoPush: **Confirm Before Push** (default on): Ask before pushing when Auto Push is enabled. Only applies when Auto Push is on.
config.showStatusBarItem: Show the WTF Commit icon in the status bar.
config.baseUrl: **Custom only.** API Base URL when **Provider** is `Custom`. Built-in providers ignore this — use **Provider Overrides** to change their endpoint/model.
config.baseUrl.description: API Base URL for the Custom provider only.
config.model: **Custom only.** Model name when **Provider** is `Custom`. Built-in providers ignore this — leave empty for the provider default, or use **Provider Overrides**.
config.model.description: Model name for the Custom provider only.
config.ignorePaths: Extra file or directory name patterns to exclude from the diff sent to the AI. Each entry is matched against a path segment (for a bare name like `generated`) or as a filename suffix (for an entry starting with `.` or `*`, e.g. `*.snap`, `.gen.ts`). Matches are case-insensitive. Built-in filters (lock files, build outputs, binaries, etc.) always apply. Set to `[]` to disable these defaults.
